faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.text: Short answers to help you understand cooperative training and choose your next step with confidence.
faq.answer_1: It is an experience that connects what you study with practical application, helping you develop your skills, get to know the work environment and meet your university's graduation requirements.
faq.question_2: How do I apply using the (Register now) button?
faq.answer_2: Click "Register now", choose the track that matches your university (Imam University, a Saudi university or an international university), then fill in the data-collection form and attach your official documents.
faq.question_3: How long is the training and how is it delivered?
faq.answer_3: The duration depends on each university's study-plan requirements (from 8 weeks up to a full semester), and training is delivered on site, in a blended format or remotely, depending on the vacancy.
faq.question_4: How do I choose the right field and program?
faq.answer_4: Browse the available vacancy cards and read the tasks and field learning outcomes to choose what fits your major and career path.

about.title: About Us
about.statement: From academic knowledge to professional field experience.
about.text_after: ) is a Saudi platform specialized in the travel, tourism and religious tourism industry (Hajj and Umrah). It connects university students with accredited cooperative training (Co-op) opportunities inside and outside Saudi Arabia, and serves university students internationally.
about.image_alt: Two Saudi students studying together in front of the Kaaba and travel landmarks
about.vision_text: To be the leading national platform and reference center for organizing and modernizing cooperative training tracks in travel, tourism, Hajj, Umrah and related technologies, and the main driver turning academic knowledge into professional field experience that leads the sectors of the future, in line with Saudi Vision 2030 and the 2027 labor-market targets.
about.mission_text: To enable local and international university students to undertake academically accredited field-training experiences at leading organizations and companies in travel, tourism and services for the Guests of Allah, and to equip them with applied skills in the most in-demand fields such as travel technology and AI, Umrah and Hajj experience management, financial technology (FinTech), luxury hospitality and digital media — ensuring they meet graduation requirements and land their first job with confidence.
about.pathway_imam_title: Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University Track
about.pathway_imam_text: A dedicated track serving the university's students and making it easy to link their study plans with open field opportunities.
about.pathway_saudi_text: Serving all students of public and private universities across the Kingdom to meet their direct field-training requirements.
about.pathway_international_text: A dedicated system serving scholarship students abroad and students of universities worldwide, coordinating and accrediting their field opportunities inside and outside the Kingdom.
about.pillar_sector_text: A professional focus on travel, tourism and religious tourism (Hajj and Umrah) and the related digital and financial solutions.
about.pillar_linking_text: A single link bringing together the student, the academic supervisor and the host organization for follow-up and evaluation.
about.pillar_accreditation_text: Training opportunities designed specifically to count toward accredited credit hours across all majors.
about.pillar_alignment_text: A direct focus on promising career and field opportunities in the future labor market.
